body:
**A quiet window**
- The open window no longer keeps the graphics card busy while nothing happens. A hidden busy spinner kept spinning and made the window redraw at every screen refresh; now it spins only while the app works.

**Also new**
- **Settings ▸ Interface language ▸ Smooth scrolling:** turn it off to scroll as Windows does, without the glide.

**Install:** unzip `uemm_2.4.1.zip` into a folder you can write to, for example `Documents\UE MM`, and start `UEModManager.exe`. One zip for every game. It needs the [.NET 8 Desktop Runtime (x64)](https://dotnet.microsoft.com/download/dotnet/8.0).

**Update from an older version:** the app offers the update at start; one click installs it. Or replace `UEModManager.exe` with the new one. The `Data` folder stays. `uemm_phantom-blade-zero_2.4.1.zip` is the same file under its old name, for older versions of the app.

**Something does not work?** In the app, open Settings ▸ Report a problem, copy the report and open an [issue](https://github.com/KintaroModding/uemodmanager/issues) with it.
